title: Heidrun Code needs programs that are not installed
installWith: To install it, run this command in a terminal:
herdr.name: Herdr
herdr.reason: Heidrun Code cannot show a terminal or a coding agent without Herdr.
herdr.after: After the installation, click “Start Herdr” in the main window.
herdr.tooOld.reason: Heidrun Code needs Herdr 0.9 or later, and the Herdr on this computer is older. Heidrun Code cannot show a terminal or a coding agent with it.
herdr.tooOld.after: After the update, quit Heidrun Code and open it again.
ngrok.name: ngrok
ngrok.reason: Only the mobile access uses ngrok. All the other parts of Heidrun Code work without it.
ngrok.after: Then create a free account at ngrok.com, and run the command ngrok config add-authtoken followed by your token. This notice does not show again for ngrok.
